Gold.note: Central bank buying and geopolitical hedging support prices.

Silver.note: Strong solar panel demand and monetary premium drive outperformance.

Copper.note: Structural deficit from energy transition and tight concentrate supply.

Uranium.note: Persistent structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear build-out.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and slowing EV demand growth weigh on pricing.

Nickel.note: Continued Indonesian supply growth and LFP battery substitution limit upside.

Zinc.note: Mine supply constraints and low smelter treatment charges tighten the market.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and constrained steel margins pressure demand.

Coal.note: Structural demand decline for thermal coal and soft global steel output.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic export controls and long-term EV motor demand provide a floor.

Manganese.note: Steady steel alloy demand offsets uncertain high-purity battery adoption.

PGM.note: Supply constraints in South Africa and hydrogen economy potential support prices.

Potash.note: Geopolitical supply risks and steady global agricultural demand maintain bias.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and strong green transition demand tighten market.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and iron ore provides steady cash flows.
